providers.licensePolicy: Use the existing paper/read-only account for internal research, archive only entitled responses locally, and do not redistribute provider data.

series.endpointSemantics: Exact catalog-pinned SPY and QQQ stock contracts requested through reqHistoricalData with duration=40 Y, barSize=1 day, whatToShow=TRADES, useRTH=1 and formatDate=1.
series.fieldSemantics: Daily regular-session OHLC and volume; IBKR documents TRADES history as split-adjusted but not dividend-adjusted.
series.publicationBehavior: Current historical reconstruction acquired after the fact; it is not a first-seen event stream.
series.revisionBehavior: Every callback payload, exact contract, request identity and response boundary is pinned by hash and never overwritten.
series.licenseRestriction: Internal account-entitled research only; no raw redistribution.
series.missingnessPolicy: Require unique ordered XNYS sessions and every completed month final session; never synthesize a missing close.
series.decisionReason: Read-only qualification returned 8,456 SPY sessions from inception and 6,917 QQQ sessions from inception through 2026-09-04. Sponsor cash distributions remain separate exact inputs.

series.endpointSemantics: The same exact contracts requested with whatToShow=ADJUSTED_LAST; IBKR requires an empty endDateTime for this series.
series.fieldSemantics: Daily close adjusted for splits and dividends according to IBKR; paired return ratios can diagnose cash events but rounded values are not the target's cash source.
series.publicationBehavior: Current historical reconstruction acquired after the fact.
series.revisionBehavior: The first response is pinned; later upstream adjustments cannot overwrite it.
series.licenseRestriction: Internal account-entitled research only; no raw redistribution.
series.missingnessPolicy: Diagnostic comparison only; absence or mismatch cannot be imputed into sponsor distributions.
series.decisionReason: Useful for independent distribution-date reconciliation, but rounded adjusted closes and omitted early events make inferred cash unsuitable for the exact target.

providers.licensePolicy: Retain one offered workbook only in the local ignored research archive, cite State Street, and do not redistribute any raw workbook or table.

series.endpointSemantics: Official downloadable SPDR Historical Distributions OOXML workbook, filtered to ticker SPY and CUSIP 78462F103.
series.fieldSemantics: Ex-date, record date, payable date, dividend, short-term capital gain and long-term capital gain per share; total target cash is the sum of the three cash fields on ex-date.
series.publicationBehavior: The workbook is updated in place and explicitly labels ex-date as the date shares cease carrying the declared distribution.
series.revisionBehavior: Pin workbook bytes and receipt metadata; later workbooks cannot modify this audit's snapshot.
series.licenseRestriction: Local internal research cache only; State Street material must not be copied, transmitted or disclosed to third parties.
series.missingnessPolicy: Require exactly 135 unique SPY ex-dates from 1993-03-19 through 2026-06-18; blank component fields mean zero, never an absent event.
series.decisionReason: The official workbook supplies exact inception-length SPY cash events and independently matches the transient Tiingo event count.

providers.licensePolicy: Use one browser-saved page/table snapshot for personal noncommercial or internal research and page caching only; no automated repeated access, mining, republication or raw redistribution.

series.endpointSemantics: Official QQQ sponsor product table saved once through a normal browser, then imported into a hash-verified local archive without automated network access.
series.fieldSemantics: Ex-date, record date, pay date, total distribution per share, ordinary income, gains, return of capital and liquidation distribution; total distribution per share is reinvested on ex-date.
series.publicationBehavior: The product table is updated in place; the imported browser snapshot fixes the observed table for this audit.
series.revisionBehavior: The saved bytes, parsed record count and receipt metadata are immutable and verified offline.
series.licenseRestriction: Personal noncommercial/internal use and page caching only; no automated repeated extraction or raw redistribution.
series.missingnessPolicy: Require exactly 88 unique QQQ ex-dates from 2003-12-24 through 2026-06-22, including 2004-12-17 and 2005-06-17 events absent from IBKR adjusted history.
series.decisionReason: The sponsor table is the exact QQQ cash source, but automated access currently returns HTTP 406; a one-time browser snapshot is mandatory before dataset acquisition.

providers.licensePolicy: Do not persist, archive or use Starter/Trial response rows in Cycle 1.

series.endpointSemantics: Starter-account EOD endpoint transiently checked for coverage only; no provider rows were retained.
series.fieldSemantics: Raw and adjusted OHLCV, cash dividend and split factor fields.
series.revisionBehavior: Not applicable because persistent capture is prohibited on the configured plan.
series.licenseRestriction: Tiingo's August 5, 2026 terms prohibit Starter and Trial users from writing, saving, archiving, backing up or otherwise retaining Tiingo data persistently.
series.decisionReason: The free account passed coverage, but its storage prohibition is incompatible with the required immutable raw archive.

runtimeCoverageGates.confirmationResolutionRule: For each instrument, reserve the final 96 months with complete 12-month labels after all core-source coverage gates pass; record exact dates in the dataset manifest without changing scientific fields.

protectedFieldPolicy: This audit changes sources and coverage evidence only. The preregistration hash, target formulas, feature definitions, models, gates, thresholds, seeds, decision vocabulary, no-HMM rule and ten-evaluation budget remain unchanged.
